sections.name: File setup
sections.title: OCR environment settings template
sections.what: Lists each OCR setting with a default or blank value and a short note on what it controls.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets developers configure the service without reading the code.
sections.watch_out: Copying the storage defaults into a shared environment exposes a known login to anyone who knows the defaults.

summary: A template listing the OCR service settings: environment, queue address, object storage login, optional Google Vision key, and Tesseract language codes.
purpose: Lets a developer set up the OCR service with local defaults.
why: Likely reason: documents the setup and leaves the Google key blank because that fallback is optional. Reason for the defaults is not stated.
how: Lists the environment and log level, then the Redis queue address, the storage endpoint, access key, secret key, and bucket name, then the optional Google key and the Tesseract language codes.
inputs: Edited by the developer to real values.
outputs: Values the OCR service reads at startup.
risks: The storage login and password are the well-known local MinIO defaults and must be changed for any shared setup. The language setting is not passed to Tesseract in the visible engine code.
debug: If documents cannot be fetched, check the storage endpoint and bucket name. If text reading is poor for a language, check the language setting and whether the engine applies it.
